events.verdict: Davison (BOS) extends his arm into Simpson's (CHA) chest while defending the drive to the basket, affecting his SQBR.

Simpson (CHA) places his hand on  Davison's (BOS) hip and pulls him to the ground while jostling for the loose ball and rebounding position. Additionally, Scheierman (BOS) moves through the lane and makes incidental contact with Simpson.
While defending along the perimeter, Scheierman (BOS) reaches for the ball and dislodges it, any additional contact to Diabate's (CHA) arm is considered incidental.
Queta (BOS) makes clean contact with the ball and deflects it away from Sims (CHA) as the steal occurs.
Simpson (CHA) makes clean contact with the ball and dislodges it away from Scheierman (BOS) in the backcourt.
Baugh (CHA) and Pritchard (BOS) engage and disengage with one another on the perimeter while moving to a picking position.
Queta (BOS) gets to the ball and cleanly takes it out of Baugh's (CHA) hands during the rebound.
Baugh (CHA) gets to the ball and blocks Queta's (BOS) layup attempt.
Salaun (CHA) commits a take foul on Pritchard (BOS) at the end of the game.
Diabate (CHA) briefly grabs and releases Walsh's (BOS) arm during the inbound play.
Scheierman (BOS) reaches in and cleanly blocks Simpson's (CHA) layup attempt.
